title: SQL injection in login handler
description: Black-box: a quote in the username field changes the login response, indicating unparameterized SQL.

title: Reflected XSS in search results
description: The q parameter is reflected unescaped into the results page; a script payload executes.

title: SSRF in webhook URL fetch
description: The callback_url is fetched server-side with no allowlist; internal metadata endpoints are reachable.
evidence: fetch of http://127.0.0.1 returns internal page

title: Verbose stack trace on error page
description: A 500 page shows a framework stack trace. Informational; dev profile only, not reachable in the shipped config.
evidence: only with DEBUG=1 which ships disabled
